name: Control electronics and cryogenics
blurb: Papers relevant to operating, benchmarking, integrating and using a semiconductor spin-qubit quantum computer of at least 16 qubits that is co-located with and integrated into an HPC system.

touchstones.text: cryogenic control electronics and cryo-CMOS for spin qubits
wiring, filtering and readout chain of a dilution-refrigerator quantum computer
power budget and heat load of qubit control at scale
spin qubit operation at elevated temperature
